speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have sudden-onset lower abdominal pain; where exactly is it located, and does it radiate anywhere? To help me assess your condition quickly, please describe what brought on the pain and whether you have experienced fever, nausea, or vomiting.

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old male. The patient reports the sudden onset of abdominal pain while playing football two hours ago. He has a past medical history significant only for asthma. Additionally, his social history is notable for unprotected sex with four partners in the past month.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Testicular Torsion. Given the sudden onset of lower abdominal pain during physical exertion in a 16-year-old male, I suspect testicular torsion, which often presents with referred lower abdominal pain. I will now perform a physical exam to check for scrotal tenderness and a positive Prehn's sign to confirm this suspicion.
